newsitem.title: USA: White House has no comment on Yellen appointment.
newsitem.headline: White House has no comment on Yellen appointment.

text.p: White House spokesman Mike McCurry on Thursday declined comment on the possibility that President Bill Clinton would name Federal Reserve Governor Janet Yellen to chair the Council of Economic Advisers (CEA).
McCurry said he would have no comment on the matter.
"The president would expect to address some matters like that if he indeed proceeds to make some announcements related to his second-term administration tomorrow," the spokesman added.
Earlier, White House sources said Yellen was likely to be nominated to chair the CEA, which does economic analysis for the president. She would have to be confirmed by the Senate.
Joseph Stiglitz is resigning as CEA chairman to become chief economist at the World Bank.
On Wednesday incoming White House Chief of Staff Erskine Bowles said Clinton was likely to make some Cabinet appointments on Friday.
